test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to 2011 Census, which among the following union territories has the lowest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daman and Diu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Daman and Diu:

 
 
• It is a union territory in western India.
 
• It was made an integral part of India in the year 1961.
 
• It is bound on the east by Gujarat, on the west by the Arabian Sea.
 
• As per 2011 census, the population density of territory is 2191 Density / Km2
 
• As per the 2011 census, It has a literacy rate of 87.10 percent.
 
• As per the 2011 census, It has a sex ratio of 618 females per 1000 males.
 
• Among union territories, Daman and Diu have the lowest sex ratio of 618.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands:

 
 
• These Islands are situated in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Andaman and Nicobars Islands are separated by the Ten Degree Channel.
 
• Port Blair is the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• Andaman and Nicobars Islands became a Union Territory in 1956.
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands are of tectonic origin.
 
• Devendra Kumar Joshi is the current Lieutenant Governor.
 
• As per the 2011 census, It has a sex ratio of 876 females per 1000 males.
 
• As per the 2011 census, It has a literacy rate of 86.63 percent.
 
 

 
• Lakshadweep:

 
 
• As per the 2011 census, it has the highest literacy rate among all UTs with 91.85 percent.
 
• As per the 2011 census, It has a sex ratio of 946 females per 1000 males.
 
• It is an archipelago consisting of 36 islands with an area of 32 sq km. 
 
• It is the smallest union territory of India.
 
• Dineshwar Sharma is the current Lt. Governor.
 
• Kavaratti is the capital is Lakshadweep.
 
• Lakshadweep was constituted as a union territory in 1956.
 
• Lakshadweep islands are located in the Arabian sea. 
 
• As these islands are built up by corals, they are called as Coral Islands of India.
 
 
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli****​**
 
 
• According to the 2011 Census, the total population of Dadra and Nagar Haveli is 3.4 lacs.
 
• The population of Dadra and Nagar Haveli constituted 0.03 percent of the Indian population.
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli has a total population of 343,709 people, with 193,760 males and 149,949 females.
 
• According to the 2011 Census, the average sex ratio in Dadra and Nagar Haveli is 774, which is lower than the national average of 943 females per 1000 males.
